image_prompts: Scene 1 (0-10s): A frustrated trader staring at a chaotic computer screen filled with overlapping charts, red warning signs, and too many indicators; visual of information overload; text overlay: 'Tired of losing money because you're trading alone?'

Scene 2 (10-20s): Split screen showing a trader missing a buy signal (price moving up while they hesitate), then an emotional reaction (facepalm, stressed); icons of fear and greed appear; conveys pain of emotional trading and missed entries.

Scene 3 (20-30s): Clean, modern dashboard interface of CrowdWisdomTrading: real-time crowd sentiment gauge, top 5 daily setups list, AI alert popping up on a smartphone, and live trading room video feed in the background; highlights solution and ease of use.

Scene 4 (30-40s): Animated proof points: counter rising to '50,000+ members', graph showing '+34% avg return', badge '76% win rate', and logos of MarketWatch, Benzinga, TradingView appearing with a verification checkmark; builds credibility.

Scene 5 (40-50s): Diverse trader testimonials: a young professional checking profits on a laptop with a smile, a veteran trader giving a thumbs-up in a trading room, and a side-by-side transformation from a red losing statement to a green profitable statement; social proof and transformation.

Scene 6 (50-60s): Call-to-action screen: URL 'crowdwisdomtrading.com/trial' prominent, button 'Start Free Trial - No Credit Card', background of traders celebrating, timer showing '7 days free'; urgent and clear CTA.
